CustomField.description: Set to true by the Events Portal (Route A) when it created a brand-new Opportunity for this hand raiser. When true, the MQL trigger creates the MQL as Converted with Conversion_Type__c = "Created Opportunity". When false or null (Route B), the MQL is created as New for sales review. Cleared by the trigger after processing.
CustomField.label: Hand Raiser Opp Is New
